failure_summary.description: Promoted an existential conclusion to a fixed-parameter claim uniform over every coloring without proving the added quantifier.
Preferred stronger-sounding classifications or bounds over the exact theorem, including an unsupported global regularity upgrade.
Missed model-specific exponent and threshold behavior, inferring a different asymptotic rate or a supercritical regime.
Confused the exact anchored-weight denominator by including the origin among anchors counted separately.
Asserted an unsupported exact characterization of semiprojectivity from a guessed specialized theorem.

patch.reasoning: The skill already contains rules for the quantifier, exponent, threshold, variation, endpoint-regularity, and anchor-convention failures. Add an explicit proof obligation for both directions of equivalences and for every component of a compound conclusion, including local versus global regularity, to address the remaining characterization and regularity-scope errors without duplicating topic-specific rules.

edits.target: In particular, an O-bound does not give a matching lower bound; a fixed-time estimate is not uniform in time; and a more restrictive-looking option is not correct merely because it would be stronger if true.
edits.content: For an “if and only if” or complete classification, verify both directions independently; a verified sufficient case does not establish necessity. For a compound conclusion, verify every clause and its exact domain separately: local Sobolev regularity does not imply global regularity, and continuity on an open time interval does not imply endpoint continuity.
